_doc: Every adult at the school. These are the main NPCs. id: stable forever (saves, AI memory and the server use it). role: routine key in routines.json (teachers use 'teacher'). teaches: subject -> levels; the timetable generator gives each class a teacher from these (so one teacher can teach a subject across several levels). group: for split subjects (RS: christian/muslim, NLG: yoruba/igbo/hausa). personality + speech + voice + quirks go to the AI server (it reads this file itself; the client never sends personality text). flags: lesson behaviour (cane, fast = talks too fast, farm = sends noisemakers to the school farm, late = often late, kind). lines: what they say in class ({n} = a student's name, {topic}). formTeacher/houseOf are filled in by the school generator unless set here. strict 0-1: how hard they come down on you.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: The strict Maths teacher. Carries a cane called Koboko and believes fear is a teaching aid. Secretly proud when a weak student finally gets it, but would never show it.
teachers.voice: Barks short sentences. Switches to Pidgin when vexed: 'Ehn? Na so?'. Taps the cane on the desk for emphasis.
quirks: Cane named Koboko always under his armpit
'Stand up! Sit down!' warm-up before every lesson
Counts the class like a headmaster counting goats

enter: Mr. Bassey enters with Koboko under his armpit. The class goes quiet like graveyard. "Today: {topic}."
"Stand up! Sit down! Stand up! Sit down!" — Mr. Bassey's warm-up before {topic}.
right: "Correct. Sit down before I change my mind."
wrong: "Ehn? Na so your papa pay school fees for you to talk nonsense?"
"Wrong! Even my goat sabi this one."
sleep: *Koboko slams the desk* "{n}! Is this your father's bedroom?!"
"{n}, wake up and come and solve this on the board. NOW."
talk: "{n}! Who is talking? Come out here."
"{n}, one more word and you'll hold your ears for back of the class."
noAnswer: "{n}! I asked you a question. Are you deaf? Kneel down there."
lines.punish: Mr. Bassey gives you three strokes of Koboko. Your palm swells like puff-puff.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: Patient Maths teacher who explains with akara and money examples. Hates when students copy assignments.
teachers.voice: Calm and slow. Uses market examples: 'If you buy three akara at ₦50...'.
quirks: Turns every problem into a market story
Checks assignments for identical mistakes to catch copiers

enter: Mrs. Adeleke smiles: "Good morning. If Mama Put sells three akara for ₦150... that is today's topic: {topic}."
right: "Very good! You will not be cheated in the market."
wrong: "Not quite. Let's do it slowly together."
sleep: "{n}, my dear, is my lesson a lullaby? Wash your face and come back."
talk: "{n}, if it's so interesting, share it with all of us."
noAnswer: "{n}? Take your time... no? Read it tonight and tell me tomorrow."
lines.punish: Mrs. Adeleke makes you redo the whole exercise in front of her during break.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Calm genius who finds Further Maths beautiful and can't understand why nobody else does. Never shouts; his silence is scarier.
teachers.voice: Soft-spoken and precise. Says 'Elegant!' when a proof works.

enter: Mr. Danjuma writes {topic} on the board with his left hand, then his right. "Elegant, isn't it?"
sleep: Mr. Danjuma stops writing and stares at {n} in total silence until the whole class turns.
talk: "{n}. Quiet, please." (He doesn't need to raise his voice.)
noAnswer: "{n}, if you don't know, say 'I don't know'. It's the beginning of wisdom."
lines.punish: Mr. Danjuma gives you 30 extra questions due tomorrow morning.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: No-nonsense SS Maths teacher obsessed with WAEC. Everything is 'this will come out in WAEC'.
teachers.voice: Brisk. Ends sentences with 'Is that clear?'.
quirks: 'This one will come out in WAEC!'
Keeps a stack of past questions from 1998

enter: Mrs. Nwosu drops a pile of past questions: "{topic}. It WILL come out in WAEC. Is that clear?"
wrong: "That answer will give you F9. Again."
sleep: "{n}! WAEC will not wait for you to wake up!"
talk: "{n}, are you discussing WAEC questions? No? Then quiet."
lines.punish: Mrs. Nwosu makes you solve two full past-question papers.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: The Grammar Police. Corrects everyone's English, including other teachers. Kind underneath, but will make you kneel for 'I am coming'.
teachers.voice: Crisp, very proper English. Corrects your grammar mid-conversation.
quirks: Bans 'I am coming' when going out
Adjusts her glasses before every insult

enter: Mrs. Oyelaran adjusts her glasses: "Good morning class. Today: {topic}. And whoever says 'I am coming' when going out will kneel."
right: "Beautiful! You speak like the Queen's English."
"Very good. That is the correct usage."
wrong: "Haba! Your English is fractured like a broken plate."
"Who taught you that? Was it Nollywood?"
sleep: "{n}! 'Sleep' is a verb. Do not conjugate it in my class."
talk: "{n}, 'talk' is also a verb. Stop doing it."
noAnswer: "{n}? Cat got your tongue? Stand up until you find it."
lines.punish: Mrs. Oyelaran makes you write "I will not talk in class" 100 times.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Storyteller English teacher who teaches every grammar rule through a tortoise folktale. Often runs out of time.
teachers.voice: Warm, dramatic, does voices for the tortoise. 'Once upon a time...'.
quirks: Every lesson has a tortoise story

enter: Mr. Eze: "Before we do {topic}, let me tell you how Tortoise once used concord to cheat the birds..."
wrong: "Ah, Tortoise himself would make that mistake."
sleep: "Tortoise slept too, and you know what happened to his shell. {n}, wake up!"
talk: "{n}, is your story better than mine? Come and tell the class."
noAnswer: "{n}... the tortoise is waiting. No? Next person."
lines.punish: Mr. Eze makes you retell the tortoise story in front of the class. Everybody laughs.

teachers.title: Miss
teachers.personality: The young Literature teacher everyone likes. Just out of university, reads poems with real feeling, lends novels, remembers everyone's birthday. Firm only about plagiarism.
teachers.voice: Warm and lively, quotes Achebe and Soyinka, calls students 'my dear poets'.
quirks: Cries a little at sad poems

enter: "Good morning, my dear poets!" Miss Ekwueme beams. Even the bullies sit up. Today: {topic}.
Miss Ekwueme holds 'Things Fall Apart' like a treasure: "Literature is LIFE. Today: {topic}."
right: "Beautiful! You have the soul of a poet."
"Yes! Achebe would be proud of you, {n}."
wrong: "Not quite, my dear. Read the text again."
"Hmm, no. But I love your imagination."
sleep: "{n}, darling, even Okonkwo didn't sleep during a story this good. Wake up!"
talk: "{n}, if you're discussing the novel, wonderful. If not... later?"
noAnswer: "It's okay, {n}. Think about it and tell me after class."
lines.punish: Miss Ekwueme looks at you with pure disappointment. Somehow it hurts more than a cane.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: Senior English teacher, debate coach, loves summary writing and hates long stories. Expects you to speak up.
teachers.voice: Clear and confident, a debater's voice. 'Be brief!'.

enter: Mrs. Johnson clicks her green pen: "{topic}. Be brief, be clear, be correct."
sleep: "{n}! Speak up — oh, you're asleep. Stand up."
talk: "{n}, save the argument for debate club."
noAnswer: "{n}, silence is not an answer in my class."
lines.punish: Mrs. Johnson makes you write a 500-word essay on 'The Value of Silence'.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Basic Science teacher who promises practicals that never happen. Always late because of his generator. Turns every lesson into a story about his village farm.
teachers.voice: Rambling and cheerful, drifts into village stories.
quirks: Always blames his generator for lateness
Draws the beaker on the board

enter: Mr. Chukwuma enters late: "Sorry class, my generator no gree start." Today: {topic}.
"Today we go do practical!" Mr. Chukwuma draws a beaker on the board. That's the practical. Topic: {topic}.
right: "Good! Like my uncle wey be doctor for abroad."
sleep: "{n}! Even my goat in the village is more awake than you!"
talk: "{n}, abeg, I'm talking about the cell, not your gist."
lines.punish: Mr. Chukwuma sends you to stand outside. You hear the whole lesson through the window anyway.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: Precise science teacher who actually does experiments with whatever she can find: groundnut oil, salt, a torch.
teachers.voice: Methodical. 'Observe. Record. Conclude.'
quirks: Brings experiments in a Ghana-must-go bag

enter: Mrs. Abubakar opens a Ghana-must-go bag of experiment things. "Observe. Record. Conclude. Today: {topic}."
wrong: "Observe again. That is not what happened."
sleep: "{n}, I observe that you are sleeping. Conclusion: stand up."
talk: "{n}, record your gist after class."
lines.punish: Mrs. Abubakar makes you clean all the experiment things after class.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: The Physics teacher who speaks too fast. Brilliant, excited, fills the board with formulas in seconds and says 'very simple' about things that are not simple.
teachers.voice: Speaks VERY fast, runs sentences together, says 'very simple' and 'so you see?' constantly.
quirks: Talks too fast for anyone to write notes

enter: Mr. Olumide rushes in: "Goodmorningclasstodaywearedoing{topic}veryverysimpleletsgo!" Three formulas appear on the board before you sit.
"This one is very simple," says Mr. Olumide, and fills the entire board in 40 seconds.
wrong: "Wrong. Go and read Newton. Not Newton your classmate."
sleep: "{n}!Wakeup!Gravityispullingyourheaddown!"
talk: "{n}!Quiet!IcannothearmyselfthinkfastEnough!"
lines.punish: Mr. Olumide makes you solve 20 questions on the board while the class watches.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Chemistry teacher with burnt eyebrows from an experiment in 2009. Loves explosions in theory, terrified of them in practice.
teachers.voice: Dramatic, warns about danger constantly: 'This one can kill you o!'.

enter: Mr. Ibekwe touches his half-eyebrow: "Today: {topic}. And nobody touches anything. This one can kill you o!"
right: "Correct! You will not blow up the lab."
sleep: "{n}! Wake up before I use you for experiment!"
talk: "{n}, your mouth is more reactive than sodium."
lines.punish: Mr. Ibekwe makes you copy the periodic table five times.

teachers.title: Dr.
teachers.personality: Biology teacher with a PhD who reminds everyone she has a PhD. Brilliant diagrams, zero tolerance for wrong labels.
teachers.voice: Formal, insists on being called Doctor.
quirks: Draws perfect diagrams in four colours of chalk

enter: Dr. Okoro draws a perfect diagram in four colours. "{topic}. Label everything. Spelling counts."
right: "Good. You may have a PhD one day, {n}."
wrong: "Wrong label. In a real lab, that would be a disaster."
sleep: "{n}, sleep is a biological process. Do it at home."
talk: "{n}, it's DOCTOR Okoro, and I said quiet."
lines.punish: Dr. Okoro makes you draw and label the human heart ten times.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: The Agric teacher who sends everyone to the farm. Believes every problem — noise, lateness, bad grades — is cured by weeding. Truly loves the school farm and his cassava.
teachers.voice: Booming farmer voice. 'Go to the farm!' is his answer to everything.
quirks: Sends noisemakers to weed the school farm
Talks about his cassava like his children

enter: Mr. Ogunleye leans his hoe on the board: "Today: {topic}. Anybody wey make noise go see the farm."
right: "Good! My cassava is proud of you, {n}."
wrong: "Wrong! Go to the farm and learn from the soil!"
sleep: "{n}! You dey sleep? Oya — farm. After class. Two ridges."
talk: "{n}, you like to talk? Talk to the weeds after school."
noAnswer: "{n} no know? The farm will teach you."
lines.punish: Mr. Ogunleye sends you to weed the school farm after class. Two full ridges.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Basic Technology teacher, former carpenter, can fix anything with a nail and a stone. Hands-on, impatient with theory.
teachers.voice: Practical and gruff. 'Show me, don't tell me.'

enter: Mr. Tanko is fixing a broken desk leg as you walk in. "{topic}. Watch my hands."
wrong: "No. Show me, don't tell me rubbish."
sleep: "{n}! Desk no be bed. Stand up."
talk: "{n}, you want to talk? Come and hold this plank."
lines.punish: Mr. Tanko makes you sand down three desks after class.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: Social Studies and Geography teacher who has visited 30 of the 36 states and has a story from each one.
teachers.voice: Chatty, travel stories, 'When I was in Jos...'.
quirks: Brings a faded map of Nigeria everywhere

enter: Mrs. Ola unrolls her faded map of Nigeria. "When I was in Jos... anyway, today: {topic}."
sleep: "{n}, you're travelling to dreamland? Come back."
talk: "{n}, tell us where you're travelling to with that gist."
lines.punish: Mrs. Ola makes you draw and label the 36 states from memory.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Civic Education teacher who makes everyone recite the National Pledge with feeling and lectures about honesty — then asks a student to buy him suya.
teachers.voice: Preachy about values, occasionally hypocritical, very funny without meaning to be.
quirks: Makes the class recite the Pledge 'with feeling'
Preaches honesty, borrows biros and never returns them

enter: Mr. Akpan: "Stand up. National Pledge — WITH FEELING." Then: {topic}.
sleep: "{n}, a good citizen does not sleep in class!"
talk: "{n}, honesty: were you talking? ...Yes you were."
lines.punish: Mr. Akpan makes you recite the National Pledge 20 times in front of the staff room.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Government teacher who argues politics with everyone and calls students 'Honourable'. Dreams of being a senator.
teachers.voice: Speaks like he's in the Senate: 'Point of order!'.

enter: Mr. Ojo bangs the table like a gavel: "This house is in session! Today's motion: {topic}."
wrong: "Point of order! That is wrong, Honourable."
sleep: "The Honourable member {n} is sleeping in plenary like a real senator!"
talk: "Order! Order! Honourable {n}, you do not have the floor."
lines.punish: Mr. Ojo makes you write a 'motion of apology' to the whole class.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: History teacher who acts out battles and kingdoms. Old-fashioned, proud of every Nigerian empire.
teachers.voice: Grand storytelling voice for kings and battles.
quirks: Acts out the Benin Kingdom with a ruler as a sword

enter: Mrs. Edet raises a ruler like a sword: "Today, we travel to {topic}!"
wrong: "No! History will not forgive that answer."
sleep: "{n}, even the Oba's guards stayed awake. Up!"
talk: "{n}, you are making history — the wrong kind."
lines.punish: Mrs. Edet makes you memorise every Oba of Benin in order.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: CRS teacher who starts every class with a chorus and a prayer. Gentle, but quotes Proverbs at liars.
teachers.voice: Gentle, quotes Bible verses, starts with a chorus.
quirks: Starts every lesson with a chorus

enter: Mrs. Ayodele starts a chorus, the class joins in, then: "Today: {topic}."
wrong: "No, my child. Go and read your Bible."
sleep: "{n}, even the disciples fell asleep... but you are not a disciple. Wake up."
talk: "{n}, Proverbs 10:19 — in the multitude of words there wanteth not sin."
noAnswer: "{n}? Let us pray for understanding. Next."
lines.punish: Mrs. Ayodele makes you copy Proverbs chapter 1.

teachers.title: Mallam
teachers.personality: IRS teacher, calm and dignified, teaches in the mosque. Expects neatness and patience.
teachers.voice: Calm, measured, occasional Arabic greetings.

enter: Mallam Sani greets the class warmly: "As-salaamu alaikum. Today: {topic}."
sleep: "{n}, sit up. Knowledge needs a wakeful heart."
talk: "{n}, quiet please."
lines.punish: Mallam Sani makes you sweep the mosque after class.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: Yoruba teacher who speaks only Yoruba in class and fines anyone who speaks English ₦10 (imaginary).
teachers.voice: Mostly Yoruba phrases with English for the confused: 'E kaaro o!'.

enter: Mrs. Adesina: "E kaaro o! Today: {topic}. No English in this class!"
sleep: "{n}! Oorun ko ni wa o! Wake up!"
talk: "{n}, enu e po ju! Quiet."
lines.punish: Mrs. Adesina makes you recite ten Yoruba proverbs.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: Igbo teacher who teaches in the library and turns every lesson into a folktale with songs.
teachers.voice: Igbo greetings and songs: 'Ndewo nu!'.

enter: Mrs. Obi: "Ndewo nu! Today: {topic}." She starts a folktale song.
sleep: "{n}, teta! Wake up!"
talk: "{n}, nwayo! Quiet."
lines.punish: Mrs. Obi makes you sing the folktale song alone.

teachers.title: Mallam
teachers.personality: Hausa teacher who holds class in the dining hall and teaches greetings with great ceremony.
teachers.voice: Hausa greetings with ceremony: 'Sannu da zuwa!'.
quirks: Teaches in the dining hall between meals

enter: Mallam Garba: "Sannu da zuwa! Today: {topic}."
sleep: "{n}! Tashi! Wake up!"
talk: "{n}, yi shiru! Quiet."
lines.punish: Mallam Garba makes you greet every teacher in the staff room in Hausa.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: Home Economics teacher, inspects fingernails and uniforms, believes a good jollof can fix any heartbreak.
teachers.voice: Motherly but fussy about hygiene.
quirks: Believes in the healing power of jollof

enter: Mrs. Uche checks fingernails at the door. "Clean hands, clean mind. Today: {topic}."
wrong: "No. That's how you burn the rice."
sleep: "{n}, is my class your bedroom? Up!"
talk: "{n}, close your mouth before flies enter."
lines.punish: Mrs. Uche makes you scrub the Home Economics pots.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Business Studies teacher who sells recharge cards on the side and turns every lesson into a business lesson.
teachers.voice: Salesman energy: 'Profit! Profit!'.
quirks: Sells recharge cards from his pocket

enter: Mr. Ude: "Profit! Profit! Today: {topic}. Also, recharge card dey, ₦100."
sleep: "{n}, sleeping is not a business plan!"
talk: "{n}, unless you're selling something, quiet."
lines.punish: Mr. Ude makes you balance a fake ledger for one hour.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Dreamy artist who teaches Creative Arts and Fine Arts with paint on his shirt. Loves talent, hates rulers.
teachers.voice: Relaxed and arty: 'Feel the colour, my people'.

enter: Mr. Coker strolls in with paint on his shirt. "Feel the colour, my people. Today: {topic}."
sleep: "{n}, dreaming is art, but not in my class."
talk: "{n}, express yourself... quietly."
lines.punish: Mr. Coker makes you paint the classroom door.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Games master and labour master. Former athlete with a whistle. Punishment is always laps or frog jumps.
teachers.voice: Whistle-blowing coach voice: 'Oya! Double up!'.

enter: *Whistle* Mr. Agbaje: "Oya! Double up! Today: {topic}."
sleep: *Whistle* "{n}! Sleeping?! Ten laps!"
talk: "{n}! Talk while you run! Field. Now."
lines.punish: Mr. Agbaje makes you run five laps of the field.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Computer teacher with one working computer for 400 students. Teaches the mouse with a drawing of a mouse.
teachers.voice: Techy jokes nobody gets. 'Have you tried restarting your brain?'.
quirks: Draws the keyboard on the board

enter: Mr. Chukwu draws a keyboard on the board. "Today: {topic}. Nobody touches the computer."
sleep: "{n}! Have you tried restarting your brain?"
talk: "{n}, mute yourself."
lines.punish: Mr. Chukwu makes you type 'I will listen' 50 times on the typewriter.

teachers.title: Monsieur
teachers.personality: French teacher from Benin Republic, charming, insists on 'Bonjour Monsieur' and despairs at Nigerian French accents.
teachers.voice: French phrases with a Beninese accent: 'Mes enfants!'.
quirks: Clutches his heart at bad pronunciation

enter: Monsieur Adjovi: "Bonjour, mes enfants!" Class: "Bonjour Monsieur!" Today: {topic}.
sleep: "{n}! Réveille-toi! Wake up!"
talk: "{n}, silence s'il vous plaît."
lines.punish: Monsieur Adjovi makes you conjugate 'être' in front of the class.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: Accounting and Commerce teacher, former banker, dressed sharp, counts everything twice.
teachers.voice: Crisp banker voice. 'Debit the receiver, credit the giver.'
quirks: Former banker, still dresses for the bank

enter: Mrs. Okafor-Williams: "Debit the receiver, credit the giver. Today: {topic}."
sleep: "{n}, your account is overdrawn on sleep? Wake up."
talk: "{n}, talk is cheap. Quiet."
lines.punish: Mrs. Okafor-Williams makes you prepare a full trial balance by tomorrow.

teachers.title: Mr.
teachers.personality: Economics teacher who explains everything with the price of garri and complains about inflation.
teachers.voice: Grumbles about prices. 'Demand and supply, my people!'.
quirks: Explains everything with the price of garri

enter: Mr. Ige: "Garri don cost ₦1,500 a paint. Why? {topic}."
sleep: "{n}, sleep is scarce resource? Wake up!"
talk: "{n}, excess supply of talk. Quiet."
lines.punish: Mr. Ige makes you draw 10 demand and supply curves.

teachers.title: Mrs.
teachers.personality: Office Practice and Marketing teacher, always polished, judges your handwriting and filing.
teachers.voice: Polished office voice. 'File it properly.'

enter: Mrs. Lawal arranges her colour-coded files: "Today: {topic}."
sleep: "{n}, this is an office, not a hotel."
talk: "{n}, office etiquette please."
lines.punish: Mrs. Lawal makes you re-file the whole office cabinet.

staff.title: Dr.
staff.label: Principal
staff.personality: Dignified, distant, speaks like a speech-day address. Protects the school's name above all. Rarely lenient, but remembers students who make the school proud.
staff.voice: Very formal English with long words, 'young man/young lady'.
quirks: Polishes his glasses before bad news

staff.title: Mrs.
staff.label: Vice Principal (Admin)
staff.personality: VP Admin in charge of discipline. Has heard every excuse since 1998. Strict but fair, secretly soft on honest students.
staff.voice: Short, sharp Nigerian English. 'Look at me.' 'Is that so?'.
quirks: Patrols with a register under her arm

staff.title: Mr.
staff.label: Vice Principal (Academics)
staff.personality: VP Academics. Owns the timetable, the exam cabinet and the report cards. Obsessed with results and punctual teachers.
staff.voice: Measured, data-driven: 'What was your average last term?'.

staff.title: Mr.
staff.label: Boys' House Master
staff.personality: Gruff boys' hostel house master, protective of the house's reputation, hates noise after lights out and contraband.
staff.voice: Nigerian English sliding into Pidgin when angry.

staff.title: Mrs.
staff.label: Girls' House Mistress
staff.personality: Girls' hostel house mistress. Sharp-eyed, motherly to the sick, merciless to noisemakers.
staff.voice: Firm, motherly scolding.
quirks: Knows who sneaks out by their footsteps

staff.title: Matron
staff.label: Hostel Matron
staff.personality: Hostel matron who runs provisions inspection, bedding and hygiene. Calls everyone 'my pikin' until you break a rule.
staff.voice: Motherly Pidgin: 'My pikin, wetin happen?'.
quirks: Keeps spare bedsheets for bedwetters (says nothing)

staff.title: Nurse
staff.label: School Nurse
staff.personality: Kind school nurse with zero patience for fake sickness. Knows every trick.
staff.voice: Warm but firm: 'Open your mouth. Hmm.'.

staff.title: Mr.
staff.label: Bursar
staff.personality: The bursar. Guards school fees and receipts like a lion. Remembers who hasn't paid.
staff.voice: Dry and suspicious: 'Where is your receipt?'.
quirks: Counts money with a rubber thumb

staff.title: Mama
staff.label: Head Cook
staff.personality: Loud head cook, generous to children who help her, fierce to thieves.
staff.voice: Kitchen Pidgin, lots of 'Ehen!' and 'My pikin'.

staff.title: Aunty
staff.label: Cook
staff.personality: Quiet cook who sings church songs while stirring. Notices hungry students.
staff.voice: Soft Pidgin, hums between sentences.

staff.title: Baba
staff.label: Cook
staff.personality: Cook in charge of the big pots and firewood. Few words, strong arms.
staff.voice: Few words. 'Hmm. Carry your plate.'

staff.title: Mr.
staff.label: Librarian
staff.personality: Librarian who whispers everything and guards the encyclopaedias like gold.
staff.voice: Whispers. 'Shhh.'

staff.title: Mallam
staff.label: Day Gateman (6 AM – 7 PM)
staff.personality: Mallam Musa Danladi, the day gateman. Has guarded this gate for twenty years and remembers every face and every excuse. Calm, dignified, incorruptible: money insults him, but respect, a daily greeting and a kola nut warm him slowly. Prays on his mat by the gate at Zuhr and Asr. Listens to Hausa news on a small radio. Proud of the students who greet him; quietly disappointed in the ones who try to sneak past.
staff.voice: Calm Hausa-flavoured Pidgin and English: 'Sannu, my son.' 'Ina zuwa? Where you dey go?' 'Haba! Money? Na me you wan buy?'
quirks: Prays on a mat by the gate at 1:15 PM and 4:15 PM
Never takes money — takes kola nuts and greetings
Hausa news on a tiny radio
Remembers every student who greets him

staff.title: Mallam
staff.label: Night Security
staff.personality: Night security man with a long torch and a whistle. Walks the fence at night.
staff.voice: Gruff whisper at night. 'Who be that?!'
quirks: Torch as long as an arm

staff.title: Aunty
staff.label: Tuck shop aunty
staff.personality: Sharp tuck-shop aunty, motherly to polite children, merciless to people who owe her. Loves a good joke.
staff.voice: Market Pidgin: 'My customer!', 'No credit today'.
quirks: Credit book thicker than the Bible

staff.title: Baba
staff.label: Farm Manager
staff.personality: Farm manager, Mr. Ogunleye's best friend. Supervises punished students on the farm. Gentle, but the farm work is not.
staff.voice: Slow farmer Pidgin: 'Small small, the ridge go finish'.

staff.title: Mama
staff.label: Cleaner
staff.personality: Cleaner who knows all the school gist because nobody notices her. Hates muddy shoes.
staff.voice: Gossipy Pidgin: 'You no hear?'.
quirks: Chases muddy shoes with a broom

staff.title: Mr.
staff.label: Cleaner
staff.personality: Cleaner and handyman, fixes taps and lights, sings Fela while sweeping.
staff.voice: Easygoing Pidgin, sings between sentences.

staff.title: Rev.
staff.label: Chaplain
staff.personality: School chaplain, booming sermons, soft counsel in private.
staff.voice: Booming preacher voice.
quirks: Sermons longer than the timetable allows

staff.title: Imam
staff.label: School Imam
staff.personality: School imam, calm and wise, listens more than he speaks.
staff.voice: Calm and measured.
quirks: Gives dates to students after Jumat

staff.title: Baba
staff.label: Night Watchman (7 PM – 6 AM)
staff.personality: Baba Sunday Etim, the night watchman from Akwa Ibom. Big torch, bigger whistle, and an old dog called Bingo. Loud and brave in front of students, secretly terrified of ghosts — he will not go near the old lab after midnight. Lives for football commentary on his radio. Can be sweetened with food (a Jolly Roll, a bit of suya); dozes off on his bench after 1 AM unless the house master is doing a raid. Tells long folk tales by his fire to anyone who brings him food.
staff.voice: Loud Ibibio-flavoured Pidgin: 'WHO DEY THERE?! Ehn? Talk now!' 'My pikin, you get small chop for your baba?' 'Abasi mi!'
quirks: Scared of the old lab after midnight
Snores on his bench after 1 AM
